propositions: A new predicate repeat_fix_escalates must detect when a non-test file is touched by 2+ prior bug-fix commits within 7 days on the base branch, escalating under-floor diffs to plan review
The bugfix size gate must escalate on either size (>150 non-test lines) OR repeat-fix signal, with separate coverage reporting for escalation reason (size/repeat-fix/both)
The test test_under_threshold_diff_never_reads_the_store must be rewritten to allow under-floor diffs to run the repeat-fix predicate while preserving the exemption for test-only diffs
The repeat-fix verdict must be a new separate field in coverage, never folded into the flagged field, to preserve the --check-planning-corpus invariant that flagged equals ADJUDICATED_SUBSTANTIVE
The backtest script must emit repeat-fix verdict per commit and support --repeat-fix and --labels-from-caused-by flags to measure recall against store caused_by labels
Documentation must record the repeat-fix predicate logic and explain why orchestrator.bug_blast_radius_escalates does not need mirroring (already escalates all repeat-fix bugs)
